title: Go Bro On-Demand Service Booking Platform
description:
Go Bro is an on-demand service-booking platform where customers can request everyday help such as babysitting, plumbing, carpentry, and A/C repair, connecting them with providers for the service they need, when they need it.

It pairs a PHP/Laravel backend and MySQL database with a React Native mobile app (published on the Google Play Store) and Vite.js/Node.js tooling on the web side, delivering the booking experience across both mobile and web.
